metadata.name: aireg-add
metadata.description: Find, read, install and update skills and agents from a registry, in this project or for the user. Use when asked to add or connect a registry, install or read a skill or agent, see what a registry offers, check that installed skills are current, or keep them checked in CI.

spec.name: aireg-add
spec.description: Find, read, install and update skills and agents from a registry, in this project or for the user. Use when asked to add or connect a registry, install or read a skill or agent, see what a registry offers, check that installed skills are current, or keep them checked in CI.
spec.compatibility: Needs the aireg CLI and git, on macOS or Linux.
